selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'shield' or 'helmet'.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, scratches, and texture consistency, ensuring no AI-generated smearing or unnatural gloss.
To verify the sharpness of the boundary between the metal plate and the background, and check for any melting or fusion artifacts at the rim.
To validate the 3D curvature of the plate and ensure the depth map aligns with the visual cues of the raised ridge and concave/convex surfaces.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the metal surface and the lighting. AI generators often struggle with consistent specular highlights on curved metallic surfaces. Check if the reflections warp logically around the central ridge. Also, inspect the rivet holes: do they have proper depth/shadows, or do they look like flat painted circles? Verify that the leather/fabric straps have a distinct texture from the metal and do not bleed into it.
